title: SPLA/84/2020 of STATE OF UTTARAKHAND Vs MUKESH NAYAL

paras.text:
SPLA No. 84 of 2020 with
GA No. 47 of 2020
Honíble Ravi Malimath, J.
Honíble N.S. Dhanik, J.
Shri J.S. Virk, learned
assistant government advocate for the
State/ appellant.
The respondents are served
and unrepresented.
For the reason assigned, leave
to appeal is granted.
Appellant is permitted to
prosecute this appeal.
There is a delay of 175 days in
filing the appeal. The reason assigned
for the delay is that permission was
received from the Law Department
little belatedly in view of pending covid
situation.
On hearing learned counsel, we
are of the view that the same
constitutes a sufficient cause. Hence,
the delay condonation application no.
1595 of 2020 is allowed. Delay in filing
the appeal is condoned.
Admit.
Call for records.
Paper book to be prepared.
Post for hearing in the usual
course.
 (N.S. Dhanik, J.) (Ravi Malimath, J.)
 23.07.2020
SKS
